show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/Bm8zT6
show.description: Spoiled rich girl Suhani thinks she’s got the perfect groom, until her sassy, middle-class father Tough Daddy pulls the plug on her wedding just days before the big day. What follows is a hilarious war of egos, culture clashes, and unexpected emotions as Suhani and her stubborn dad clash over love, freedom, and family honor. In this chaotic rollercoaster, cancelling the wedding might just be the best thing that ever happened.
